responsibility: Header for the C++ modules mapper client wrapper around Cody::Client. It defines the module_client class, including storage for subprocess and signal state, flag access, and the static open/close entry points used by the modules front end to communicate with an external or in-process mapper service.
same_name_distinction: Declares the module_client wrapper around Cody::Client, including stored subprocess/signal state, flag access, and static open/close entry points. Unlike mapper-client.cc, it does not contain the logic for parsing mapper options or establishing/tearing down connections.
